solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Smoking accommodation?

parts.note: reads like a smoking room or a smokers' carriage

explanation.walkthrough: 'Accommodation' suggests a place where people stay; here it is something that holds the thing being smoked.
explanation.definitionFit: A cigarette holder is a tube that holds a smoke, so it literally accommodates the item being smoked.

clue.text: Greek writer describing Scots one?

parts.note: the writer of the clue, the setter, refers to themself as I
describing means on the subject of, so it gives ON
Ian is the stock Scottish man's name in crosswords

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a Greek author is writing about a Scotsman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek writer' looks like one phrase, but 'Greek' is the definition and 'writer' is the setter, I.
explanation.definitionFit: Ionian means from Ionia, the ancient Greek region and its people, so it is a Greek adjective.

clue.text: Brutal strike in area that's up-and-coming

indicators.note: in a down clue, coming up means the run of letters is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to lam is to strike or thrash

explanation.surface: A violent blow lands in a neighbourhood that is becoming fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's up-and-coming' turns LAM + IN + A (LAMINA) to read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal used as an adjective means physical and savage, as in animal brutality.

clue.text: See former wife, one travelling far and wide on medical programme

parts.note: an ex is a former wife or husband
ET, the extra-terrestrial, has travelled an enormous distance
ER is the American hospital television drama

explanation.surface: Look at an ex-wife who goes globetrotting while appearing on a hospital show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' reads as a command to look, but it is a bishop's see, the area a bishop governs.
explanation.definitionFit: Exeter is a cathedral city whose bishop's diocese is the see of Exeter.

clue.text: Smart-Aleck Tory getting involved with lovable chef

indicators.note: getting involved suggests the letters of the two names are mixed up together and rearranged

explanation.surface: A clever-clever Conservative politician takes up with a charming cook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting involved with' mixes TORY and LOVABLE CHEF into one rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone too clever by half is a show-off whose cleverness irritates, which is what a smart-aleck is.

clue.text: Film unlucky one in Duck Soup?

definitions.text: Film unlucky one in Duck Soup?

parts.words: Film unlucky one in Duck Soup?
parts.note: names a Bond film that is also a kind of duck, the unlucky bird that might end up in duck soup

explanation.walkthrough: Duck Soup is a Marx Brothers film, steering you towards comedy; the answer is a James Bond film that shares its name with a diving duck.
explanation.definitionFit: Goldeneye is both a 1995 James Bond film and a species of diving duck that could be cooked.

clue.text: Study image in it, in assembly

indicators.note: in tells us the study and image go inside the word it

parts.note: taken as written
a den is a study or private room for work
a tiki is a carved Polynesian image of a human figure

explanation.surface: An instruction to examine a picture as part of a group gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' marks the container. Identikit was an old police kit of facial features, assembled piece by piece to build a picture of a suspect, so 'assembly' fits.
explanation.definitionFit: An Identikit picture is put together from a set of features, so it is an assembly.

clue.text: Group of reporters in Shanghai?

parts.note: reads as a pack of journalists in a Chinese city, but shanghai also means to force someone into service

explanation.walkthrough: To shanghai a sailor was to force him aboard ship, which is what this team did; read literally it is a gang of the press.
explanation.definitionFit: A press gang forcibly enlisted men into the navy, which is exactly what shanghaiing someone means.

clue.text: See 1
Hip team overseeing one patient identify criminal abuse of Trust?

parts.note: hip means fashionable, in
a side is a sports team
Job of the Bible is the byword for patience

explanation.surface: A trendy team supervising a patient spots a breach of trust at a hospital trust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overseeing' places the pieces in order and 'identify' is a link. Job's patience is proverbial: 'the patience of Job'.
explanation.definitionFit: An inside job is a crime committed by someone trusted within the organisation, so it abuses that trust.

clue.text: Dandy who's employed to give lectures?

definitions.meaning: a dandy here is a vain, handsome young man
answered by a university lecturer: a don is employed for that

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is a question whose answer, split as A DON IS, spells the word.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of the beautiful youth of Greek myth is used for any handsome, vain young man.

clue.text: Trifle with beautiful woman holding a gun

indicators.note: the beautiful woman holds the gun, so those letters go round it

parts.note: a belle is a beautiful woman
gat is old American slang for a gun

explanation.surface: Someone flirts with an attractive woman who is carrying a weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trifle' looks like a verb, as in trifle with someone; it is a noun, a trivial thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A bagatelle is a thing of little importance, which is a trifle.

clue.text: Mate has row in English

indicators.note: in puts the row inside the abbreviation for English

parts.note: a din is a noisy row

explanation.surface: A friend gets into an argument in English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mate' reads as a friend, but it is checkmate, the finish of a chess game.
explanation.definitionFit: Checkmate is the conclusion of a game of chess, its close.

clue.text: Performance of Carmen may rest on this

definitions.text: Performance of Carmen may rest on this

parts.words: Performance of Carmen may rest on this
parts.note: suggests an opera staging, but read Carmen as car men: a car's handling depends on the distance between its axles

explanation.walkthrough: Carmen is Bizet's opera; split as car men it points to motoring, where performance can depend on a car's axle spacing.
explanation.definitionFit: The wheelbase is the distance between a vehicle's front and rear axles, which affects how the car behaves.

clue.text: Sporting accumulator — twenty races on the day?

parts.note: a score is twenty
a racecard lists the races run on a given day

explanation.surface: A betting accumulator on twenty races held on one day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accumulator' suggests a multiple bet; here it is the card on which runs or points are added up.
explanation.definitionFit: A scorecard is where a sports score builds up, so it accumulates the tally.

clue.text: Angry letters following crime

parts.note: a black mood or look is an angry one
mail is letters sent by post

explanation.surface: Furious letters are sent after an offence.
explanation.definitionFit: Blackmail, extorting money by threats, is an offence in law.

clue.text: There's a film all about her previous 24 hours

definitions.text: There's a film all about her
definitions.meaning: the 1950 film All About ... is all about a woman of that name

explanation.definitionFit: The film All About Eve names her, and an eve is the day before a special occasion.

clue.text: The decline of electronic books

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for electronic, as in e-book
B is an abbreviation for book, doubled as BB for the plural

explanation.surface: The falling-off in sales of e-books.
explanation.definitionFit: An ebb is a falling-off or decline, like the ebb of the tide.

clue.text: The Days of The Raj

indicators.note: of says the answer is drawn out of the next words

explanation.surface: A title for a history of British rule in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' takes the answer from inside 'The Raj'.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a period of time, as in 'in my days' meaning in my time.

clue.text: American hero ordering free lunch by rink

indicators.note: ordering means putting the letters into a new sequence

explanation.surface: Someone orders a free lunch beside an ice rink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordering' looks like asking for food; it is rearranging FREE LUNCH BY RINK.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mark Twain character who rafts down the Mississippi is a famous American fictional hero.

clue.text: Having a spin in car — but I give a couple a lift

definitions.text: I give a couple a lift

indicators.note: having a spin means turning round, so these letters are read backwards
in says the letters are found within the words car but

explanation.surface: Someone out for a drive offers a lift to a pair of passengers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' picks ARB from 'car — but', and 'Having a spin' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A bra lifts and supports a pair of breasts, a couple in the cheeky sense.

clue.text: Improve wayward children with no heart

indicators.note: wayward means unruly, so the letters are jumbled
the heart of the word is its middle letters, which are removed

explanation.surface: An attempt to improve disobedient, unfeeling children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no heart' takes LD from CHILDREN to leave CHIREN, which 'wayward' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrich something is to make it better or more valuable.

clue.text: This asthmatic may have a cunning plan

definitions.meaning: a wheezy, whistling breath is typical of asthma
British slang for a clever scheme or trick

explanation.definitionFit: A wheeze is a rasping breath, and in British slang a clever scheme or trick.

clue.text: She may get into the habit in order to take charge

definitions.text: She may get into the habit in order to take charge

parts.words: She may get into the habit in order to take charge
parts.note: sounds like forming a routine, but means a nun putting on her robe as head of a religious order

explanation.walkthrough: 'habit' is a nun's robe and 'order' is a religious order, not a sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbess is the female head of a convent, who wears the habit and runs her order.

clue.text: Hardly a no-strings-attached roadblock!

parts.note: a police barrier that, split up, describes cord being on, the reverse of no strings attached

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as CORD ON and it means strings are attached.
explanation.definitionFit: A cordon is a line of police or tape blocking off an area, a kind of roadblock.

clue.text: Round Thailand hospital is extra unpleasant smell all right, according to regulations?

indicators.note: round says the extra goes around the letters for Thailand and hospital

parts.note: a bye is a cricket extra, a run scored without the bat
T is the international vehicle registration code for Thailand
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
BO is body odour
OK means all right

explanation.surface: A Thai hospital visit ends with a nasty smell that turns out to be fine by the rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Round' puts T and H inside BYE. In cricket, a bye is a run scored without the ball touching the bat.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something by the book means following the rules strictly.

clue.text: What Grace will turn into

definitions.meaning: a graceful look suits or flatters, which is the old sense of the word as befit
to change into something, as in a caterpillar changes into a butterfly

explanation.walkthrough: The verb has a transitive sense, to suit (that hat becomes you), and the everyday sense of turning into.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to suit someone gracefully and to grow or change into something.

clue.text: Always paced worriedly about islands

indicators.note: about puts the rearranged letters around always
worriedly suggests the letters of paced are agitated into a new order

parts.note: ever means always, as in ever hopeful

explanation.surface: Someone constantly paces nervously around an archipelago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worriedly' scrambles the pacing to CAPDE, and 'about' wraps it round the word for always; 'islands' is the whole definition for this Atlantic archipelago.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Verde is an island nation in the Atlantic off West Africa.

clue.text: Med waterway with which fantasist is more concerned?

indicators.note: concerned is read as troubled or stirred up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A question about which sea channel interests a daydreamer more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concerned' rearranges FANTASIST IS MORE. The channel lies between Sicily and mainland Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: This narrow sea channel separates Sicily from Calabria in the Mediterranean.
